digest.component_or_area: Reconcile Bridge observability / CloudWatch metrics and alarms
propositions: Reconcile Bridge run failures on GitHub Actions produce no CloudWatch signal and are visible only in workflow step summaries or error annotations, leaving infrastructure monitoring blind to API token outages and similar failures.
GitHub Actions workflows can publish metrics to CloudWatch via OIDC federation but this repository has no workflow-level metric publishing for the reconcile bridge.

A new narrowly-scoped IAM role must be created granting only cloudwatch:PutMetricData constrained to the rebar/host namespace, federating the existing GitHub OIDC provider, without widening existing roles like rebar-terraform-plan.

The reconcile-bridge workflow must publish bridge_run_failures=0 on success and bridge_run_failures=1 on failure every run to make the publisher itself observable and distinguishable from a broken publisher.

A CloudWatch alarm on rebar/host:bridge_run_failures with period=3600 and threshold=1 (GreaterThanThreshold) alarms on the second failure within an hour, reducing false positives from transient blips while catching sustained outages within ~40 minutes.
